Local_chatbot.label: Ask questions about your documents.
Local_chatbot.summary: A chatbot that answers questions in Persian using your documents. It finds relevant passages with semantic search and includes a dashboard for managing the content.

jarvisjoon-local-agent.label: A coding assistant that runs locally.
jarvisjoon-local-agent.summary: A local coding assistant that can look through files and use tools to help with your code. It starts in read-only mode and asks for approval before each edit.

graphBackon.label: Find your way around a codebase.
graphBackon.summary: A tool for exploring Python projects through a searchable 2D code map. It runs locally, uses AST analysis to read the code structure, and serves the results through FastAPI.
